item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: No, it's "cut". Yelling "cut" implements a mindwipe on the subject, replacing their personality with that of an actor playing that subject in a movie. The actor thinks "okay, the director yelled 'CUT', so I can stop pretending to be that person now, and be myself again".

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
Just a little confused by this:

When "cut" is called through the device, it removes the learned behaviors and society norms of the individual, replacing them with those of the actor.

Shouldn't that be:

When "action" is called through the device, it removes the learned behaviors and society norms of the individual, replacing them with those of the actor.

Other than that, it's a cool idea and I like the presentation. No vote either way for now.

item.content:encoded: I really like this. The idea itself is mindbending (heh) and it sounds exactly like something AWCY? would do. (Before this I didn't even imagine there'd be director-playwrights in the group, but now it's obvious!) What I really like about it, though, is the sense that with their artistic poking they've stumbled across something possibly quite disturbing. That's what I took away from it, anyway…
